_prov.source: New York State Senate, Open Legislation API
_prov.method: Session 2025 Senate bills (ceremonial resolutions excluded). 'Prime sponsor' = Brisport is prime sponsor; 'Co-sponsor' = a listed co-sponsor. Date shown is the introduction date; subject tags are keyword-matched on the bill title and summary.
_prov.caveats: Status is the latest recorded action ('In Committee' = introduced, not yet advanced). Subject tags are automated approximations. Members co-sponsor far more bills than they lead.
